posts.text: “Good morning. It’s Monday. So yesterday I did some barfing. I had my reasons. The humans were concerned but I’m fine. It’s spring grass season and that stuff is nummy. But I do have some advice: choose you barf spots carefully if you want your humans to react positively. Also, I love you.”

Just imagine what these thieves would do for a shipment of Klondike bars.


KITKAT (@KITKAT)

Regarding recent press coverage





— https://nitter.net/KITKAT/status/2038313618509377852#m

New York City still had elevator operators when I was a kid.


James Stephenson (@ICannot_Enough)

Nobody is skeptical of autonomous elevators because nobody alive today was even around to see a human elevator operator in real life before the last one got laid off. Automation is far safer.



— https://nitter.net/ICannot_Enough/status/2038244393648267480#m

“Good morning. It’s Sunday. Thumb guy took us out in the dark. I did what I needed to do and then ran back home to wait for them. Then thumb guy left dressed for the bark box. Treat time was fine supply wise, but rushed. Also I love you.”

If this is true (and I think it obviously isn’t) I do wonder how to explain that Trump in literally thousands  of speeches and interviews  has never shown the depth of knowledge and felicity with facts RFK speaks of here. Is he just nervous?

Video
“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”
I forgot I’ve had an account here since 2023. Kicking the tires now.
Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
